Zoe (Acme): Heads up — our March invoice (INV-2026-03-78) is ~35% higher than what the dashboard shows. Dashboard = 1,220,431 tokens, invoice = 1,650,912 tokens. Can someone explain?
Devon (Support): Sorry about that. Quick q — did you change plan or API keys mid-month? Any chance multiple teammates spun up integration tests?
Zoe (Acme): No plan change. We only have two service keys, both used by prod. No internal test runs. We double-checked dashboard totals under Billing -> Usage (monthly).
Devon (Support): Okay. Can you DM me the account_id and the invoice pdf? I'll loop in Billing.
Zoe (Acme): Account: acct_7X9bL. PDF uploaded: INV-2026-03-78.pdf.
BillingBot: Automated note: invoice INV-2026-03-78 finalised 2026-03-31T23:59:47Z. Charged plan: Team (tier id: team-monthly), line items: tokens 1,650,912 @ $0.0008/token.
Michael (Billing): I pulled the invoice. At a glance the token line item was generated from the metering rollout job for period 2026-03-01..2026-03-31. We'll compare raw events -> aggregated tokens -> invoice item.
Sara (CS): Devon, Michael — here are the minimal repro queries I usually run. Start with raw events for the account and compare to aggregation used by billing: 
```
-- raw events
SELECT event_id, ts, request_id, event_type, model, input_tokens, output_tokens
FROM usage_events
WHERE account_id = 'acct_7X9bL' AND ts >= '2026-03-01' AND ts < '2026-04-01';

-- billing aggregation (simplified)
SELECT sum(input_tokens+output_tokens) AS tokens
FROM billing_aggregates
WHERE account_id = 'acct_7X9bL' AND period = '2026-03';
```
Kyle (DevEx): Two common mismatch causes: retries logged as separate events (different request_id), and a late ingestion window that backfills old events after the dashboard snapshot. Also check for model-level dedup rules.
Michael (Billing): Running quick counts now. Raw events sum -> 1,648,984 tokens. Billing aggregate -> 1,650,912 tokens. Dashboard snapshot API (cached) -> 1,220,431 tokens. So dashboard is low, not invoice high. Looks like dashboard snapshot didn't include late backfilled events.
Zoe (Acme): So invoice is correct? That seems surprising — dashboard UI is what our PMs look at.
Devon (Support): For transparency: our billing pipeline allowed a late ingestion window on 2026-03-30 that backfilled ~420k tokens for this account (source: embed-service retry flood). The metering service dedup happens by request_id; if requests were retried with different ids we count them.
Zoe (Acme): Hmm, we did have a deploy on 3/28 that retried failed batches for embeds. Might be related.
Sara (CS): Two actions: 1) Michael/Finance to confirm invoice correctness and whether to issue a credit for noise. 2) DevEx to add a dashboard note and improve near-real-time inclusion behavior so customers see backfills.
Michael (Billing): Finance says we should not auto-credit without reviewing root cause. I'll open a billing-review ticket and attach the raw_event sample and the backfill job logs. If the backfill is legitimately deduped duplicates caused by our retry bug, we should credit.
Kyle (DevEx): I'll add a temporary banner on the account dashboard highlighting that final invoice may include late backfills. Also will raise a ticket with infra to add request_id-based dedup across retries where safe.
Devon (Support): Michael — pls post the billing-review ticket number here once created. Zoe — we can provisionally apply a one-time invoice credit while we investigate, or put the invoice on hold if you want. Which do you prefer?
Zoe (Acme): Provisional credit would be great so our finance team can close March. Please keep me updated.
Michael (Billing): Ticket created: BR-2026-874. I've attached: sample raw_events (10 rows), backfill job id job_4981, and the aggregate diff. Next steps for us: run dedup audit on job_4981, check source service logs for retries (embed-service), and calculate candidate credit amount: ~($1,650,912 - $1,220,431)*0.0008 = ~$344.4 before taxes.
BillingBot: Note: invoice INV-2026-03-78 flagged for manual review by BR-2026-874.
Sara (CS): I'll own communication with Acme. Devon/Kyle — please paste the specific SQL used for audit so we can reproduce.
Kyle (DevEx): Audit query I used to find duplicate-ish events (heuristic):
```
SELECT request_id, count(*) as attempts, sum(input_tokens+output_tokens) as tokens, min(ts) as first_seen, max(ts) as last_seen
FROM usage_events
WHERE account_id='acct_7X9bL' AND ts >= '2026-03-01' AND ts < '2026-04-01'
GROUP BY request_id
HAVING count(*) > 1
ORDER BY attempts DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
Michael (Billing): Running dedup audit now. Early result: ~118 request_ids with multiple attempts, total tokens across duplicates ~412,000. Looks like the retries map to a single upstream job that sprayed requests due to a timeout bug.
Zoe (Acme): Thanks. Please let me know when the provisional credit is posted.
Devon (Support): Updated: provisional credit $345 posted to account acct_7X9bL (credit id CR-2026-1122). Final resolution pending BR-2026-874.
Zoe (Acme): Received, thanks all. Appreciate the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
Michael (Billing): After investigation, finance will confirm final credit amount tomorrow. We'll follow up in BR-2026-874.
Sara (CS): Closing loop once finance confirms. Logged action items: (1) Finance: finalize credit, (2) Infra: root cause for embed-service retries, (3) DevEx: dashboard backfill messaging, (4) Billing: consider dedup heuristics for metering.
Devon (Support): Marking thread for follow-up. If anyone needs raw snippets from job_4981 PM me.
Zoe (Acme): Happy to help with logs from our side if needed.
